questions.q: Over whom did David lament with a song of mourning?
questions.evidence: David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son

questions.q: How old was David when he began to reign?
questions.evidence: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years

questions.q: Which stronghold did David take, the one that became the city of David?
questions.evidence: Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion

questions.q: How did David dance before Yahweh as the ark was brought up?
questions.evidence: David danced before Yahweh with all his might
One said, “Isn’t this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, Uriah the Hittite’s wife

questions.q: Who told David, "You are the man"?
questions.evidence: Nathan said to David, “You are the man

questions.q: What did David name the son Bathsheba bore, whom Yahweh loved?
questions.evidence: She bore a son, and he called his name Solomon

questions.q: As his mule went under a great oak, what did Absalom's head catch in?
questions.evidence: Absalom was riding on his mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak, and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was taken up between the sky and earth

questions.q: For whom did David weep, "my son, my son"?
questions.evidence: As he went, he said, “My son Absalom

questions.q: What did David pay Araunah for the threshing floor and the oxen?
questions.evidence: So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver
